## 1. Logical Architecture

{{USER_EVENT_AGENT_AND_DATA_INTEGRATION_LAYER_DESCRIPTION}}

### How It Works

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph USER["1. User and Event Layer"]
        direction LR
        U["{{AUTHENTICATED_USER_AND_CHANNEL}}"]
        M["{{REQUESTED_EVENT_ENTRY_AND_RESPONSE_CHANNEL}}"]
    end
    subgraph AGENT["2. Agent Layer - Copilot Studio"]
        direction LR
        I["Global instructions<br/>Scope and grounding"]
        A["{{AGENT_NAME}}<br/>GitHub Copilot harness"]
        S["{{SKILL_CAPABILITIES}}<br/>Procedures, not service connections"]
    end
    subgraph DATA["3. Data and Integration Layer"]
        direction LR
        W["Copilot Studio Workflows<br/>Trigger / agent call<br/>Validate and respond"]
        K["{{ACTUAL_RETRIEVAL_SURFACE}}<br/>Indexed content and permissions"]
        SRC["{{SOURCE_SYSTEM_AND_CONTENT}}"]
    end
    USER --> AGENT
    AGENT --> DATA
    U -->|"Request"| A
    U -->|"Sends event inquiry"| M
    M -->|"Event triggers workflow"| W
    W -->|"Workflows invokes agent"| A
    A -->|"Returns response to same workflow"| W
    W -->|"Validates and sends response"| M
    M -->|"Response to user"| U
    I --> A
    A --- S
    A -->|"Authorized retrieval"| K
    SRC -->|"Connector ingestion"| K
    style U fill:#0078D4,color:#fff,stroke:#005A9E
    style M fill:#0078D4,color:#fff,stroke:#005A9E
    style W fill:#E07000,color:#fff,stroke:#A05000
    style A fill:#107C10,color:#fff,stroke:#004B00
    style I fill:#107C10,color:#fff,stroke:#004B00
    style S fill:#107C10,color:#fff,stroke:#004B00
    style K fill:#E07000,color:#fff,stroke:#A05000
    style SRC fill:#E07000,color:#fff,stroke:#A05000
    style USER fill:#fffde7,stroke:#aaa
    style AGENT fill:#fffde7,stroke:#aaa
    style DATA fill:#fffde7,stroke:#aaa
```

This eight-node scaffold illustrates indexed knowledge plus requested event-driven
action. Remove event/integration nodes for read-only chat designs and replace the
ingestion path for non-indexed evidence. Do not inherit Workflows or any source
system unless in scope. For ServiceNow Copilot connector ingestion, K is Microsoft
365 Search / Semantic Index and SRC is ServiceNow KB; the agent never queries SRC.

Keep three stacked layers and short labels. Use one Workflows node: event enters
Workflows first, Workflows calls the agent, the agent returns to the same node,
and Workflows validates and responds through the channel. Keep these return edges
explicit even in a simplified chart. Do not merge the mailbox with Workflows or
split invocation and delivery into apparently different workflows. State setup status in prose,
not repeated proposed/OFF banners. Link detailed contracts below.

## 3. Data Flow

### Scenario A - {{PRIMARY_FLOW_NAME}}

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User as {{USER_ROLE}}
    participant Agent as {{AGENT_NAME}}
    participant Evidence as {{ACTUAL_RETRIEVAL_SURFACE}}
    User->>Agent: {{REQUEST}}
    Agent->>Evidence: Retrieve authorized applicable evidence
    Evidence-->>Agent: Evidence or explicit limitation
    Agent-->>User: Cited response or evidence gap
```

### Scenario B - {{DISTINCT_FLOW_NAME}}

For requested autonomous email use this five-participant, eight-message example.
Adapt to the actual business flow; remove it when event-driven action is not in
scope. Do not add email to an otherwise read-only scenario.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User as {{USER_ROLE}}
    participant Mail as {{APPROVED_MAILBOX}}
    participant Flow as Copilot Studio Workflows
    participant Agent as {{AGENT_NAME}}
    participant Evidence as {{ACTUAL_RETRIEVAL_SURFACE}}
    User->>Mail: Sends inquiry
    Mail->>Flow: New email triggers workflow
    Flow->>Agent: Passes verified inquiry and context
    Agent->>Evidence: Retrieves authorized evidence
    Evidence-->>Agent: Returns relevant information
    Agent-->>Flow: Returns grounded response content
    Flow->>Mail: Validates and sends authorized reply
    Mail-->>User: Receives automated response
```

Show the routine successful path without nested validation/retry trees. Summarize
holds and failures in a short paragraph linking the matrix/runbook. Preserve
approved per-action review only if required by the scenario's authorization policy;
do not add human approval to routine autonomous replies by default. Use commas,
not literal semicolons, in message/note text (or escape a semicolon as `#59;`).
